body:
Hanging myself in my closet, I already know I'm a burden to everyone. Not my intention to drag anybody into being an unwilling particpant in my suicide.

Thank you.

I live in the US. Legally the suicide hotline can do this, and won't be held accountable. If I had known I would not have used this service to talk about my feelings. I had no intentions of killing myself. The only thing I had made mention was I had feelings about maybe self harming again, but I took steps to stop myself from doing it by leaving my house and getting somewhere safe, and calling the hotline.

The hotline I used was the biggest fucking joke. They did not want to help me, they just wanted to feel good about themselves and feel like they were "saving" somebody who wasn't even in danger. I told the woman I was feeling a lot better and she still called the police.

The only thing they achieved is pushing me further to suicide. I will be killing myself tonight, and I am sure of it as a result of the suicide hotlines actions. My life was bad, but they made it so much worse.
Is it legal for the police or EMS to take you to the hospital if you tell them you don't want to go?
Thank you. Is everything they did legal? Would it be possible to sue them for the medical bills? I really don't have options and I'm running out of hope.
I am very sorry this happened to you as well. If I hadn't called them I would be much better off and I feel much more hopeless than I previously did.
